The '''1979–80 Serie A''' season was the 78th edition of [[Serie A]], the top-level [[association football|football]] competition in [[Italy]]. The championship was won by [[Inter Milan|Internazionale]]. [[A.C. Milan|Milan]] were relegated for the first time in their history following a [[Totonero 1980|match fixing scandal]].

==Teams==
[[Udinese]], [[Cagliari Calcio|Cagliari]] and [[Pescara Calcio|Pescara]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].

==Events==
Following the creation of the [[UEFA ranking]], Italy lost two out of its four places in the UEFA Cup inherited from the Fairs Cup.
